executive_overview: Critical RCE and stack buffer overflow vulnerabilities detected in JNI exported functions of libfoo.so. Unchecked inputs flow directly into system() and sprintf(). Immediate code remediation is required.

targets.file_overview: Native shared library containing 3 exported JNI functions sharing identical insecure patterns for executing system commands.

functions.function_overview: Exported JNI function that retrieves string parameters and executes external shell commands.

findings.title: OS Command Injection via system()
findings.ai_explanation: User input from 'j_cmd' is concatenated into command_buf and passed directly to system(). An attacker can append shell operators (e.g., '; id') to execute arbitrary commands.

remediation.recommendation: Avoid invoking system(). Validate input against a strict alphanumeric whitelist before command assembly.

findings.title: Unchecked JNI String Extraction Pointer
findings.ai_explanation: GetStringUTFChars may return NULL if memory allocation fails. The pointer is used downstream without prior NULL verification.

remediation.recommendation: Check the returned pointer for NULL immediately after invocation.
remediation.fixed_code_snippet:
const char* user_input = (*env)->GetStringUTFChars(env, j_cmd, 0);
if (user_input == NULL) return NULL;

findings.title: Stack Buffer Overflow via Unbounded sprintf()
findings.ai_explanation: sprintf() formats input into a fixed-size 512-byte buffer without length checks, causing a stack overflow on large inputs.

remediation.recommendation: Replace sprintf() with snprintf() and specify explicit buffer boundaries.

findings.title: Proper JNI Resource Release Boundary
findings.ai_explanation: JNI string memory is properly released at the end of execution flow.

remediation.recommendation: Ensure ReleaseStringUTFChars is also called on all error/early return paths.

functions.function_overview: Exported JNI function exhibiting identical command execution vulnerabilities as MainActivity_init.

findings.title: Arbitrary Shell Execution via Native System Call
findings.ai_explanation: Direct invocation of system() with unvalidated input originating from Java JNI parameters.

remediation.recommendation: Remove system() invocation and replace it with safe C/C++ logic or explicit input sanitization.
remediation.fixed_code_snippet:
// Avoid system()
// Implement safe native C logic instead.

findings.title: Missing Pointer Validation on String Extraction
findings.ai_explanation: String extraction via GetStringUTFChars lacks immediate NULL check.

remediation.recommendation: Perform a NULL pointer check prior to using the extracted string.

findings.title: Unbounded Memory Copy in String Formatting
findings.ai_explanation: Risk of stack corruption due to unbounded formatting into command_buf via sprintf().

remediation.recommendation: Use snprintf() to bound the output to buffer capacity.

findings.title: JNI Memory Release Compliance
findings.ai_explanation: Standard release of native JNI string memory buffer.

remediation.recommendation: Maintain this resource release pattern across all branches.

functions.function_overview: Exported JNI function in CodeCheck component containing command injection vulnerabilities.

findings.title: OS Command Injection via Unsanitized JNI Flow
findings.ai_explanation: Direct command execution via system() using parameter string.

remediation.recommendation: Eliminate system() call and enforce input sanitization.

findings.title: Unchecked Native String Pointer
findings.ai_explanation: Pointer extracted from GetStringUTFChars used without NULL validation.

remediation.recommendation: Guard pointer usage with a NULL check.

findings.title: Potential Stack Corruption via sprintf()
findings.ai_explanation: Uncontrolled string format writing into destination stack buffer.

remediation.recommendation: Enforce explicit buffer length limits using snprintf().

findings.title: JNI String Resource Management
findings.ai_explanation: JNI string buffer deallocated successfully at function return.

remediation.recommendation: Ensure deallocation occurs under all conditional execution branches.

functions.function_overview: Static read-only memory (.rodata) and string artifacts embedded inside the ELF binary.

findings.title: Information Disclosure via Compiler Toolchain Strings
findings.ai_explanation: Full NDK compiler version and build strings exposed in the binary string table.

remediation.recommendation: Strip unneeded symbols and compilation metadata during production builds.

findings.title: Memory Allocation Primitive Reference
findings.ai_explanation: Static reference to memory allocation routines in string table.

remediation.recommendation: Ensure all dynamic memory allocations verify return pointers for NULL.
remediation.fixed_code_snippet:
void* ptr = malloc(size);
if (!ptr) { /* Handle OOM */ }
